name: Top Bar
description: A sticky top bar with brand, search, and action slots.

anatomy.description: The sticky container that keeps its slots visible while scrolling.
TopBarBrand slot for product identity on the leading edge.
TopBarSearch slot for global search in the middle.
TopBarActions slot for trailing controls such as the account menu.

dos: Use sticky for apps where global actions must stay reachable while scrolling.
Collapse secondary actions into a menu on narrow screens.
donts: Don't put page-level actions here; they belong in Page Header.
Don't stack multiple top bars; compose the slots into one.

examples.title: Brand, search, and actions
examples.description: Slots compose into full and compact headers; sticky keeps the bar visible while scrolling.

examples.title: Application shell header
examples.description: Combine brand, global search, and account actions in one persistent header.

examples.title: Compact shell
examples.description: Use the same slots for a focused route header with fewer global actions.

guidance.useWhen: An application needs a consistent global header and action slots.
guidance.avoidWhen: A page has only local controls that belong in its header.
guidance.behavior: Sticky mode keeps the bar visible while its slots remain composable.
guidance.responsive: Collapse secondary actions and move search to a dedicated mobile trigger.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the brand, search trigger, and action buttons in order.

notes: Renders a <header> element by default; use the as prop to change the element if needed.
Keep action buttons labeled with aria-label when they contain only icons.
Sticky keeps the bar in view during scrolling; use sticky={false} for an inline bar.

props.description: Keeps the bar at the top of its scrolling container.
props.name: sticky
